name: io.github.nubiia-dev/mcp-borme
description: OpenMercantil (BORME): 37 read-only tools for Spanish company search, officers, sectors and tenders

environmentVariables.name: OPENMERCANTIL_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional OpenMercantil API key (omk_...). Without it the server uses the anonymous free tier (60 requests/min, 200/day per IP).

environmentVariables.name: OPENMERCANTIL_MAX_REQUESTS_PER_MINUTE
environmentVariables.description: Local cap on requests per minute across all tools. Defaults to 60 (the anonymous tier limit); raise it for paid plans.

environmentVariables.name: OPENMERCANTIL_MAX_RESPONSE_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum size of a tool response in characters; larger results are cut with a notice. Defaults to 60000.
